recall.uz: Yulduzlar haqidagi sheʼrni tinglab oʻqiymiz, ularning rangi va issiqligini bilib olamiz.
recall.ru: Слушаем стихотворение о звёздах и узнаём об их цвете и жаре.
recall.en: We read a poem about the stars and learn about their colours and heat.

prompt.ru: Послушай и читай, следя за текстом!
prompt.en: Listen and follow along as you read!

hint.ru: Что такое звёзды на самом деле?

explanation.uz: Sheʼr osmondagi yulduzlar va bizga eng yaqin yulduz — Quyosh haqida.
explanation.ru: Стихотворение о звёздах и ближайшей к нам звезде — Солнце.
explanation.en: The poem is about the stars and the closest star to us — the Sun.

prompt.en: Tap the true facts about stars!

hint.en: Stars look tiny but are actually huge.

explanation.uz: Yulduzlar — ulkan olov sharlar, turli rangda; Quyosh ham yulduz.
explanation.ru: Звёзды — огромные огненные шары, разного цвета; Солнце тоже звезда.
explanation.en: Stars are huge balls of fire in many colours; the Sun is a star too.

statement.en: The Sun is the closest star to Earth.

why.ru: В стихотворении сказано, что ближайшая звезда — Солнце.
why.en: The poem says the nearest star is the Sun.

prompt.en: According to the text, what is this statement?

hint.en: Which star do we see by day?

explanation.uz: Toʻgʻri: Quyosh — bizga eng yaqin yulduz.
explanation.ru: Верно: Солнце — ближайшая к нам звезда.
explanation.en: True: the Sun is the closest star to us.

statement.en: Stars shine brightly during the day.

why.uz: Sheʼrda yulduzlar kechasi koʻrinishi tasvirlangan; kunduz haqida bunday gap yoʻq.
why.ru: В стихотворении звёзды видны ночью; о дне такого нет.
why.en: The poem shows stars at night; it says no such thing about daytime.

prompt.en: According to the text, what is this statement?

hint.en: When are the stars seen in the poem?

explanation.uz: «Matnda yoʻq»: sheʼr yulduzlarni kechasi tasvirlaydi, kunduzni emas.
explanation.ru: «Не сказано»: стихотворение о ночных звёздах, не о дне.
explanation.en: “Not given”: the poem shows night stars, not daytime.

prompt.ru: Соедини цвет звезды с её жаром!
prompt.en: Match a star's colour to its heat!

explanation.uz: Oq-koʻkimtir — eng issiq; sariq — oʻrtacha; qizil — salqinroq.
explanation.ru: Бело-голубые — горячее; жёлтые — средне; красные — прохладнее.
explanation.en: Whitish-blue — hottest; yellow — medium; red — cooler.

choices.en: The nearest yellow star to Earth

hint.en: The Sun is a star too.

explanation.uz: Quyosh — Yerga eng yaqin boʻlgan sariq rangdagi yulduz.
explanation.ru: Солнце — ближайшая к Земле жёлтая звезда.
explanation.en: The Sun is the nearest yellow star to Earth.

openEnd.uz: Sen yulduzlar haqida yana nima bilishni xohlaysan?
openEnd.ru: Что ещё ты хочешь узнать о звёздах?
openEnd.en: What else would you like to know about stars?

clue.ru: Что такое звёзды на самом деле?

prompt.en: Complete the sentence with the right word!

hint.uz: Yulduzlar issiq, yorugʻ va yonib turadi.
hint.en: Stars are hot, bright and burning.

explanation.uz: Yulduzlar — ulkan olov sharlar, shuning uchun yorugʻ.
explanation.ru: Звёзды — огромные огненные шары, поэтому светят.
explanation.en: Stars are huge balls of fire, so they shine.

prompt.en: Build the sentence from the words!

explanation.uz: «Quyosh — eng yaqin yulduz»: shuning uchun u katta va yorugʻ koʻrinadi.
explanation.ru: «Солнце — ближайшая звезда»: поэтому оно большое и яркое.
explanation.en: “The Sun is the nearest star”: that's why it looks big and bright.

clue.en: Which one is not a heavenly body?

hint.en: Three are in the sky, one is at home.

explanation.uz: Stol — mebel; yulduz, oy, quyosh — osmon jismlari.
explanation.ru: Стол — мебель; звезда, луна, солнце — небесные тела.
explanation.en: A table is furniture; star, moon, sun are heavenly bodies.

clue.ru: Тело, что светит ночью в небе
clue.en: A body that shines in the night sky

prompt.en: Build the word from the syllables!
